label: Coerce Text
author: Conky-Studio
description: Turn any value into a string. Lets numeric sources feed Text Label / Badge / String Join cleanly when the socket kinds would otherwise refuse the wire.
lua_expr: (function() local v = {input}; if type(v) == 'number' then return string.format('%.' .. math.floor({decimals}) .. 'f', v) end; return tostring(v or '') end)()
